title: Isabella I to the Duke of Estrada, Segovia 20 Aug 1503 (AGS PTR leg. 53 doc. 69; Bergenroth's S.E.T.c.I. L. 4 ff. 65-67), catalogue 287

documents.shelfmark: AGS, Patronato Real, leg. 53, doc. 69 (PARES 2207988), three ciphered copies X (f. 322), Y (f. 323), Z
documents.route: Isabella I (Segovia) -> Hernán Duque de Estrada, ambassador in England

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the images; the 3 Oct 1503 letter (PTR 53/72, clear copy) summarises its content

transcription.source: PARES images 1-4 and 7-8 of PTR 53/69 (988x1310 px), line strips at 4x
transcription.notes: Read into reading_X.md directly (codes with values, letter runs as plaintext, [..] for unread runs); no sign-level token file, so the length is not measured. About 480 code-group tokens counted in reading_X.md.

system.summary: Cifra general de los Reyes Católicos (Galende Díaz 1994): homophonic sign alphabet interleaved with two-to-four letter code groups (v-, x-, y-, z-, b-, c-).
system.sibling_key: Cifra general de los RRCC, the key of esp318 no. 92 (esp318/keys/cifra_general.txt).
system.notes: entries 683 = code groups in Galende's plates. Bergenroth's 'two keys of cipher' is the code/letter mixture.

prior_solution.where: Bergenroth (CSP Spain i 369, 1862) could not decipher it; Tomokiyo suggested the Galende key but gave no reading; no edition found

conditions.human_role: Project-level: set up Claude Code and posed the problem with /goal (catalogue 287 text, 'find it on PARES, apply the Galende key'). No target-specific intervention recorded.
tools: strips.py, halves.py, stack.py, zoom.py (line strips from PARES images)

solution.what: CSP Spain i 369 (BHO): Segovia 20 Aug 1503, 'two keys of cipher', not deciphered; Tomokiyo points to PTR 53/69 as a Galende-cipher letter.
PARES 2207985-2207991 (PTR 53/66-72) opened; first downloads all returned 53/72's images because PARES keys images to the last catalogo/show page of the session; refetched per record.
PTR 53/69 found to hold three ciphered copies of one letter (20 Aug, a September duplicate, 3 Oct 1503); Y dated Segovia xx de agosto, dorse 'Leg. 4 f. 65'.
Galende's Cifra general applied: first line reads 'Ya sabeys como el rey de Francia nos ronpio los dias passados la guerra en Napoles'.
Clear copy of the 3 Oct 1503 letter (PTR 53/72 f. 346) read; it summarises 'nuestras cartas de veinte de agosto' and gives vocabulary (afrontar, declarase, dos mil peones).
Copy X read line by line against Y and Z (reading_X.md): codes all consistent with the printed key; about half the letter-sign runs unreadable at 988 px.

outcome.fraction_read_source: reading_X.md: 479 code tokens and 70 letter-sign words read against 154 [..] runs of letter signs; runs average about six signs, so roughly half of the cipher tokens (codes + signs) carry a value. Not measured sign by sign.

gaps.item: Letter-sign runs, about half the cipher tokens of each copy (154 [..] stretches in reading_X.md)
gaps.detail: PARES serves 988x1310 px; signs are 8-10 px high and the alphabet has several homophones per letter; three copies collated. Needs the AGS originals or a high-resolution reproduction.

gaps.item: Two later clear notes (X verso, Z recto foot)
gaps.detail: cursive notes at the same resolution, read in part

outcome.notes: Content recovered in outline: French war on Naples, Roussillon, Fuenterrabia, Guipuzcoa, Galicia; Henry VII bound by treaty to help; request for 2000 English foot. Not about the marriage.
